qa.notes: Public installer URL currently serves an older fall-out-bug/sdp script. This branch is not buyer-safe until the sdp_lab PR lands and scripts/sdp-publish.sh updates fall-out-bug/sdp.

summary: CHANGES_REQUESTED: code/docs/test cleanup is done, but public installer mirror drift remains unresolved until post-merge publish to fall-out-bug/sdp.

findings_detail.title: Public installer mirror drift blocks buyer-safe onboarding
findings_detail.rationale: The branch intentionally points downstream users at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fall-out-bug/sdp/main/scripts/install.sh, but that public URL currently serves an older release installer. The source branch installer must be published to fall-out-bug/sdp after this PR merges.
findings_detail.suggested_fix: After merging PR #152 to sdp_lab main, run scripts/sdp-publish.sh and verify the public raw installer matches the repo-local onboarding installer.
